text:
emma: FYI our staging deploy from PR #4122 bumped the ExternalSecrets mapping and a few pods failed to mount secrets after rollout. Seeing 502s from a couple services too. rolling back?

raj: can you paste the pod events / error?

emma: pasted below — main error is ExternalSecrets controller complaining about invalid template keys and then it doesn't create the k8s Secret. Only in namespace `staging-payments`.

miguel: `kubectl -n staging-payments describe externalsecret payments-db-secret` ->
```
Events:
  Warning  ReconcileError  2m  externalsecrets-controller  failed to apply template: key "connectionString" not found in source (got "{{ .data.conn }}")
```

olivia: ah — PR changed the template to expect `.data.conn` but the vault path provider returns `stringData` fields. The TF change switched the bridge to `vaultKvV2` -> `data` root shape.

emma: that matches — I updated the mapping in terraform to use `vault/data/*` paths to normalize KVv2. Might have missed template updates for the one secret.

sre-oncall: if we revert TF quickly we can restore. What's the safe rollback command? Don't want to reapply unrelated infra.

emma: plan: 1) revert to previous commit of infra repo (hash: a1b2c3d) 2) run `terraform apply -target=module.k8s_external_secrets` in `env/staging` 3) watch ExternalSecrets controller logs + pod restarts.

raj: can we do a targeted `kubectl patch` to repair the failing ExternalSecret template while we roll back TF? smaller blast radius.

miguel: yes — quick patch to the ExternalSecret in staging to use the old template. Example patch: `kubectl -n staging-payments patch externalsecret payments-db-secret --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"data":{"connectionString":"{{ .stringData.conn }}"}}}}'` — test on one resource first.

olivia: note: `stringData` doesn't persist in CRDs — might need to use `.data` but also change provider mapping. Another option: patch the ExternalSecrets controller config to tolerate both keys for a brief window.

infra-bot: deploy triggered: infra-ci/infra-staging PR #4122 merged by emma at 2026-02-12T15:12:03Z :package: :gear:

sre-oncall: i'm happy to run the rollback. prefer targeted TF apply + controller restart over mass revert. Who can run smoke tests after? @raj? :eyes:

raj: I can run smoke tests. Steps I'll do: 1) wait for rollback apply 2) `kubectl -n staging-payments get secrets payments-db-secret -o yaml` 3) curl health endpoints for payments service (10x) and report latency/errors.

emma: ok executing revert now (applying only module.k8s_external_secrets). will post output.

emma: (output) `Apply complete! Resources: 0 added, 1 changed, 0 destroyed.` Controller rollout triggered: `deployment/extsecrets-controller restarted`

miguel: watching controller logs: `Reconciled ExternalSecret payments-db-secret -> created Secret payments-db-secret` :white_check_mark:

raj: secrets present, pods restarted and became Ready. health checks: 10/10 pass, avg latency 112ms.

olivia: follow-up: create a short TF test that validates template keys for affected namespaces before merging. Also add a checklist item in PR template to run `kubectl get externalsecret --namespace` sample.

emma: agreed. i'll open a small follow-up PR to add pre-merge checks and a regen script for templates.

sre-oncall: If anyone sees flaps, ping me. Filing a quick postmortem note in #incidents. Thanks for quick responses :thumbsup:

raj: nice work team.

emma: thanks all :)
